amendment_reason: Pinned NVIDIA checkpoint metadata and server code establish a native 32x8 action output; protocol v1 incorrectly treated 16x8 as native.
deterministic_adapter: hash and retain all 32 native rows, then take rows 0 through 15 without rescaling, interpolation, clipping, or outcome-dependent selection
scientific_legitimacy: The WAM still receives the prospectively frozen 16-step horizon and advances exactly eight steps. Only the upstream native-policy representation is corrected before execution.
forbidden: configure the 32-row checkpoint as if it were trained to produce 16 rows
discard or fail to hash the unused native rows
select policy rows using physical outcomes or downstream evaluator scores
